title: Azure Storage Services
description: Learn Azure Blob Storage, Files, Queues, Tables, and Disk Storage. Understand storage tiers, redundancy options, and when to use each service.
longDescription: This module introduces Azure's storage portfolio. You will learn how to store unstructured data with Blob Storage, share files across services with Azure Files, use Queue and Table Storage for messaging and NoSQL scenarios, and attach managed disks to virtual machines. We also cover security with SAS tokens and RBAC, and redundancy options to keep your data safe.
whatYouLearn: Store and retrieve blobs with Hot, Cool, and Archive tiers
Mount Azure Files shares using SMB or NFS
Use Queue Storage for decoupled messaging
Attach managed disks to virtual machines
Secure storage with SAS tokens, RBAC, and encryption
Choose the right replication strategy: LRS, GRS, ZRS, or RA-GRS
